metadata.title: Semi-Analytical Model for the Evolution of Stellar Binaries in the Empty Loss Cone of Massive Black Holes

notes: No eligible stars: this is a population-level semi-analytical study of simulated stellar binaries, and it does not identify any individual star as a Galactic unbound candidate. Hypervelocity stars are mentioned only generically as possible outcomes of deep tidal encounters (T:p1-b9).
